sample_unit: search terms (questions) submitted to each chatbot

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, ARI) and understandability (PEMAT-P) of chatbot uveitis answers
links.effect: GPT-4 had the lowest ARI and SMOG scores (P = .001). Mistral scored lowest on PEMAT-P understandability. All chatbots except Mistral had high intelligibility scores.
links.quote: GPT-4 had the lowest SMOG and ARI score among the chatbots evaluated, making it the easiest to read.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and understandability metrics (PEMAT-P, SMOG, ARI) of several commercial LLMs answering patient questions about uveitis without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
